label: prf:cyclotomic-orbit-sum-all-depths
title: Proof of cyclotomic orbit sum all depths
html:
Proof. Proof of cyclotomic orbit sum all depths

Proof

Step 1 (multiplication formula). The classical N-th roots-of-unity multiplication identity:

  \sum_{k = 1}^{N - 1} \mathrm{Li}_n(\zeta_N^k)
  \;=\;
  \bigl(N^{1 - n} - 1\bigr)\, \zeta(n).

The RHS is real (\zeta(n) \in \mathbb{R}).

Step 2 (extract Re / Im).

  • n odd: \mathrm{Cl}_n = \mathrm{Re}\,\mathrm{Li}_n. Taking real part of both sides: \sum_k \mathrm{Cl}_n(2\pi k/N) = (N^{1 - n} - 1)\, \zeta(n).
  • n even: \mathrm{Cl}_n = \mathrm{Im}\,\mathrm{Li}_n. Taking imaginary part of both sides: \sum_k \mathrm{Cl}_n(2\pi k/N) = \mathrm{Im}((N^{1 - n} - 1)\,\zeta(n)) = 0 (since \zeta(n) \in \mathbb{R}). \square

Verifications

Verified at 50 dps for n \in \{2, 3, 4, 5\}, N \in \{3, 4, 5, 6, 7\} (20 combinations), max residual 8.0 \times 10^{-51}. Witness: jonquiere-cyclotomic-general.witness.json.
